newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 236,800 MT were 47 percent below the week earlier and 64 percent below the 4-week average. Major increases reported for Taiwan (96,400 MT, 45,400 new sales, 52,500 destination changes), Malaysia (66,000 MT, 5,500 new sales, 60,500 destination changes), Morocco (52,700 MT, 3,400 new sales, 49,600 destination changes), and Spain (34,500 MT) were partially offset by decreases for unknown destinations (88,600 MT), Algeria (23,600 MT), and Italy (20,000 MT).

Exports of 1,068,100 MT were 9 percent over the prior week, but 9 percent less than the 4-week average. The primary recipients were Japan (295,500 MT), South Korea (220,400 MT), Taiwan (168,400 MT), and Malaysia (121,000 MT). Barley: Switches in sales of 10,600 MT from Ireland t
